requirements.summary: Add real-link-driven bright stars and high-density black-hole visualizations to the Knowledge Map.
evidence: The existing map already derives unique-neighbor degree from non-structural indexed edges; no physical mass dataset exists.

design.summary: Adaptive degree threshold for bright stars; density candidates from real cosmos groups and unique effective relations, rendered as a bounded visual metaphor.
evidence: Highlights: p97 degree cutoff with minimum degree 8, ties retained.
Black-hole candidates: groups with at least 12 members and 12 unique internal effective edges, average degree >=2.4, then p80 density cutoff, maximum 3.

implementation.summary: Implemented graph-derived highlight stars and accretion-ring overlays; added a legend and documented that black-hole appearance is not physical mass.
evidence: Added internal/server/web/starmap-gravity.js and integrated it into starmap rendering.
Highlight color, halo, and flare scale from effective degree; black-hole radius scales from group size and density.
